title: Junior Designer Color & Materials – CORE Footwear (14-month contract)
note: CMF-focused junior footwear role on Sportstyle/CORE footwear, limited to 14 months; portfolio required.

facts.summary: Junior color and materials designer for PUMA's CORE (Sportstyle) footwear, fixed 14-month contract.
facts.duties: Create collection designs, material and color combinations, trend research, and review materials under the Head of Design CORE Footwear.
facts.requirements: Completed design degree, color/material/footwear design experience, Illustrator and Photoshop, strong color and material sense.
facts.apply: Apply online via PUMA Workday with portfolio and CV.
